title: Prerequisite Check Output Schema
description: Schema for prerequisite check script JSON output

index_path.description: Path to index directory (present if index_exists=true)

freshness.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when index was last updated, copied from metadata.json (present if index_exists=true)

age_days.description: Age of index in days, calculated as (current_date - freshness_date) in days (present if index_exists=true)

is_stale.description: Whether index is stale, calculated as (age_days > 7), present if index_exists=true

files_indexed.description: Number of files in index (present if index_exists=true)

error.description: Error message if index validation failed
